## Activity

During December 2018, Central Eye Clinic completed 152 captures. Activity was delivered in accordance with the planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic maintained its scheduled service during the reporting period, with no changes to the reported capture total.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Graders recorded 2 ungradable sets, representing an ungradable rate of 1.3 per cent of captures. These images could not be used for grading and have been included in the overall activity figures. The result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review and feedback to the clinic team.

## Grading

Grading identified 29 referable results from the completed captures. The median lag from photograph to grade was 9 days. This provides the reported measure of the interval between image capture and completion of grading. Referable findings and grading turnaround should remain subject to the usual review arrangements, with any required follow-up managed through established processes.
